title: Missing inline images no longer fail a mail
The mail probe tests the platform sender
Tenant mail transport falls back to the app transport without tenant config
Email sending offers a platform default and an own SMTP server
The deprecated mailFoundationFeature constant is removed
detail: mailFoundationFeature was kept next to createMailFoundationFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createMailFoundationFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces mailFoundationFeature with createMailFoundationFeature().
